B01.title: Current balanced wand
B01.hypothesis: Local appearance competition in the existing boundary band, median9, ds2; exact previous baseline.

B02.title: Whole-field appearance classification
B02.hypothesis: Class-conditional Gaussian appearance learned from original coarse interiors relabels the entire field; sparse tile-center anchors.

B03.title: Multiscale posterior agreement
B03.hypothesis: Fit class appearance independently after 1, 4 and 12 µm averaging; combine posteriors geometrically over the whole field.

B04.title: Region snapping
B04.hypothesis: Partition converted RGB into SLIC regions; assign complete regions from original coarse-interior votes, with appearance for unlabelled regions.

B05.title: Seeded watershed
B05.hypothesis: Flood the converted-image gradient from sparse original tile-center seeds; all pixels participate.

B06.title: Graph random-walker propagation
B06.hypothesis: Screened harmonic propagation on the converted-image region adjacency graph, with coarse anchors and a weak appearance source.

B07.title: Alpha-expansion graph cut
B07.hypothesis: Optimize a multiclass appearance/Potts energy through graph-cut expansion moves on image regions.

B08.title: Finite-range CRF
B08.hypothesis: Mean-field posterior inference with contrast-weighted messages at three physical neighborhood radii.

B09.title: Geodesic competition
B09.hypothesis: Each coarse class expands along minimum cumulative appearance/edge travel cost; competing geodesic distances select the label.

B10.title: Convex total-variation partition
B10.hypothesis: Primal-dual optimization of a simplex-valued class field with appearance fidelity and isotropic TV regularity.

B11.title: Vector region active contour
B11.hypothesis: Discrete vector Chan–Vese-style region competition jointly updates class appearance means and curvature costs.

B12.title: Hierarchical region merging
B12.hypothesis: Agglomerate adjacent image regions by adaptive mean-color distance while preventing conflicting coarse-anchor mergers.

B13.title: Spectral architecture partition
B13.hypothesis: Partition the normalized image-region graph spectrally; assign classes to global appearance clusters using coarse supervision.

B14.title: Digital topology-preserving moves
B14.hypothesis: Allow full-field unary-driven label changes only at digital simple points for donor and recipient classes.

B15.title: Object-context region classifier
B15.hypothesis: Use original H&E nuclei/lumen/context features plus converted evidence to classify whole H&E regions from coarse interiors.

B16.title: Area-constrained transport
B16.hypothesis: Entropy-regularized pixel-to-class transport matches soft class masses to completed coarse tissue proportions.

B17.title: Nonlocal patch voting
B17.hypothesis: Retrieve similar multiscale converted-image patches from original coarse interiors and vote their labels, including distant tissue regions.

B18.title: Elastic mask deformation
B18.hypothesis: Optimize one smooth displacement field shared by all initial classes against image appearance; geometry, rather than independent labels, is the variable.

B19.title: Independent-solver consensus
B19.hypothesis: Combine whole-field appearance, graph propagation, TV partition and current-wand decisions; resolve tied votes by appearance.

B20.title: Coarse-supervised dilated CNN
B20.hypothesis: Fit a small per-image network on original coarse interiors using converted RGB and H&E, with class-balanced patch sampling and no fine-label access.

parameters.graph_contrast_scale: median positive squared region LAB distance

baseline: B01 native mask copied pixel-identically from the previous full-tissue result
training: original nonzero coarse-label interiors only; never completed pseudo labels as training targets
analysis: whole converted RGB field, including all unannotated tissue; sparse coarse tile-center anchors for most solvers
geometry: new solvers use approximately 1 micrometre/pixel per-axis geometry, projected nearest-neighbor to original native coordinates
final_support: unchanged independent native RGB tissue support; zero background after segmentation, every detected tissue pixel assigned
quality: original native reference > 0, unchanged; unannotated tissue excluded, removed annotated tissue penalized
primary_summary: equal datasets and equal seven conversions within each case; paired case resamples keep conversions together
